scientific_integrity: Exact global extremum cited to Horvath-Langi (2014); explicit analytic local Hessian, independent surface-area Jacobian, and a standalone symbolic replay; original research claim is the sharp probabilistic constant and marked limit, not the known maximum.
scientific_limitations: Exactly five independent surface-uniform samples on the unit two-sphere; only leading relative-volume tail and local conditional shape. Generic and previously known global optimizer; historical priority provisional; no independent validation.
title: Sharp upper-volume tail and seven-dimensional shape law for five random spherical vertices
